## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the STATUS.md file contains embedded BOMs and duplicate '## Known broken' sections, which cause issues in documentation processing and readability. By stripping the BOMs and merging the duplicate sections under a single header while preserving all 18 bullets, we will normalize the file.

## Mechanism

We will:
1. Read the STATUS.md file and remove any embedded BOM (Byte Order Mark) at the start of the file.
2. Identify all sections with the header '## Known broken'.
3. Merge the content of all such sections under a single '## Known broken' header, preserving the order of the bullets as they appear in the file.
4. Remove the duplicate headers and ensure that only one '## Known broken' section exists.
5. Write the normalized content back to STATUS.md.
